TestName: Login screen displays username and password fields
Preconditions: Client app is launched
TestSteps: 1. Open client app. 2. Observe login screen.
ExpectedResult: Username and password fields are visible and clearly labeled.

TestName: Invalid login shows clear error message
Preconditions: Client is at login screen
TestSteps: 1. Enter invalid credentials. 2. Click LOGIN.
ExpectedResult: Client shows a clear invalid credentials error message.

TestName: Successful login opens dashboard
Preconditions: Client and server are available; valid client login credentials are known
TestSteps: 1. Enter valid credentials. 2. Click LOGIN.
ExpectedResult: Dashboard is displayed and login feedback is positive.

TestName: Sign-up rejects empty required fields
Preconditions: Client is on sign-up page
TestSteps: 1. Leave required fields empty. 2. Submit the form.
ExpectedResult: Sign-up is blocked and a validation message is shown.

TestName: Sign-up rejects mismatched passwords
Preconditions: Client is on sign-up page
TestSteps: 1. Enter different password and confirm password values. 2. Submit.
ExpectedResult: Sign-up is blocked and a password mismatch message is shown.

TestName: Room selection opens correct room details page
Preconditions: User is logged in
TestSteps: 1. Open Dashboard or Floorplan. 2. Select Garage or Kitchen.
ExpectedResult: The matching room detail page opens.

TestName: Camera request button is shown only for security-enabled rooms
Preconditions: User is logged in
TestSteps: 1. Open Garage or Backyard. 2. Open a non-security room such as Kitchen.
ExpectedResult: Capture button is visible only in security-enabled rooms.

TestName: Settings page accepts IP and port changes
Preconditions: User is logged in and settings page is available
TestSteps: 1. Open Settings. 2. Change IP and port fields. 3. Save or apply if supported.
ExpectedResult: Input values are accepted and retained correctly.

TestName: Client sends LOGIN request and handles server success response
Preconditions: Server is running and client-server login flow is enabled
TestSteps: 1. Start server. 2. Start client. 3. Enter valid credentials. 4. Submit login.
ExpectedResult: Server authenticates request and client enters the dashboard.

TestName: Client sends LOGIN request and handles server failure response
Preconditions: Server is running and client-server login flow is enabled
TestSteps: 1. Start server. 2. Start client. 3. Enter invalid credentials. 4. Submit login.
ExpectedResult: Server rejects request and client shows a clear failure message.

TestName: Client requests current server status and displays returned state
Preconditions: Client is connected to running server
TestSteps: 1. Start server. 2. Connect client. 3. Trigger status request.
ExpectedResult: Client receives and displays the server state correctly.

TestName: Client sends mode change request and handles ACK response
Preconditions: Client is connected to running server and authenticated
TestSteps: 1. Log in. 2. Change system mode from client. 3. Observe response.
ExpectedResult: Server applies valid mode change and client handles the acknowledgment correctly.

TestName: Client sends device control command and receives updated status
Preconditions: Client is connected to running server and authenticated
TestSteps: 1. Log in. 2. Open a room. 3. Toggle a device. 4. Request or observe updated status.
ExpectedResult: Server processes the command and client reflects the updated device state.

TestName: Client requests snapshot and receives valid JPEG image
Preconditions: Server is running with valid snapshot source and client is connected
TestSteps: 1. Log in. 2. Open Garage. 3. Click CAPTURE HIGH-RES JPEG.
ExpectedResult: Client receives a valid JPEG and displays it in the camera panel.

TestName: Client handles server disconnect or offline state gracefully
Preconditions: Client is configured to connect to server
TestSteps: 1. Start client with server offline or stop server during client usage. 2. Perform an action requiring server access.
ExpectedResult: Client does not crash and shows a meaningful connection error.

TestName: First-time user can log in without assistance
Preconditions: Test participant has not used the app before
TestSteps: 1. Ask user to open app. 2. Ask user to log in using provided credentials. 3. Observe behavior without coaching.
ExpectedResult: User can identify fields and complete login without help.

TestName: User understands invalid login feedback
Preconditions: Test participant is at login screen
TestSteps: 1. Ask user to attempt login with invalid credentials. 2. Observe whether message is understood.
ExpectedResult: User understands why login failed and what to try next.

TestName: User can navigate from dashboard to Garage and back
Preconditions: Test participant is logged in
TestSteps: 1. Ask user to open Garage. 2. Ask user to return to previous view.
ExpectedResult: Navigation is discoverable and completed without confusion.

TestName: User can find and use the image capture feature
Preconditions: Test participant is logged in and on Garage page
TestSteps: 1. Ask user to obtain a security snapshot. 2. Observe whether they locate and use the control correctly.
ExpectedResult: User finds the image capture action without help and understands the result.

TestName: User understands device state and mode change feedback
Preconditions: Test participant is logged in
TestSteps: 1. Ask user to switch a device or mode. 2. Ask what happened. 3. Observe confidence and clarity.
ExpectedResult: User can tell whether the action succeeded and what state the system is in.

TestName: Full workflow from startup to logout succeeds
Preconditions: Client and server are built and runnable
TestSteps: 1. Start server. 2. Start client. 3. Log in. 4. Navigate rooms. 5. Control a device. 6. Log out.
ExpectedResult: Complete workflow succeeds without crashes or incorrect state.

TestName: Full security workflow captures and displays snapshot
Preconditions: Server has access to valid snapshot image and client can connect
TestSteps: 1. Start server and client. 2. Log in. 3. Open Garage. 4. Request snapshot.
ExpectedResult: Snapshot request completes end-to-end and displayed image is valid.

TestName: Invalid credential workflow prevents access and allows retry
Preconditions: Client and server are running
TestSteps: 1. Attempt login with invalid credentials. 2. Observe feedback. 3. Retry with valid credentials.
ExpectedResult: Invalid access is blocked and recovery path works cleanly.

TestName: Server offline workflow shows graceful error handling
Preconditions: Client is built; server is stopped
TestSteps: 1. Launch client while server is offline. 2. Attempt login or server-dependent action.
ExpectedResult: Client remains stable and presents a clear offline error.

TestName: State restrictions are enforced end-to-end
Preconditions: Client and server are running and connected
TestSteps: 1. Log in. 2. Move system into LOCKED or MAINTENANCE. 3. Attempt restricted device command.
ExpectedResult: Restricted actions are blocked and the user receives correct feedback.
